# Pointy swept-hair reference

Open **Pointy_HairGroom.asset** in the Hair Card Stage to edit the hairstyle.
For the lit presentation, save your current scene and open **Pointy_URP_Review.unity**.
Use the project's URP renderer with MSAA; the included ReviewPipeline/ReviewRenderer
are optional comparison assets, not automatically installed in project settings.

The groom contains 51 raw authored paths from the supplied Blender reference.
**All clump guides and cards are generated by UMA**, not imported evaluated Hair Tool geometry.
Select **Generate Hair > Primary Clumps**, then **Inspect Population**, to see the
intermediate controls. **Final Hair** restores the complete result. Selecting the
sculpt pass edits authored guides and temporarily bypasses generated populations.

The rendered example has 402 intermediate clumps and 4,122 cards; soft density,
spacing and hairline filtering reduce the requested populations. One candidate
root has no compatible influence and is rejected rather than incorrectly attached.
It is a starting point for refinement, not a pixel-identical Eevee conversion.

## Materials and textures

- The diffuse PNG is a byte-identical copy of **HairAtlasDiffuse_New**, with private
  alpha-coverage-preserving mipmap import settings. The shared original is untouched.
- Both strip rectangles match the supplied Blender hair and the existing UMA atlas
  layout. Other HairAtlasDiffuse_New variants can reuse them.
- **StrandAtlas.png** is the depth image packed in the user's supplied reference;
  the hair material uses it as a separate depth/contrast map. Alpha still comes
  from the diffuse atlas. Normal and AO reference the existing UMA textures.
- Change Roots/Tips/Root color reach in **Hair Cards > Materials & UVs**.
  The material Inspector exposes anisotropic highlights, transmission, depth,
  alpha, and diagnostics. Vertex RGBA is not consumed unless explicitly enabled.

## Scalp Mesh Modifier and production binding

**Pointy_ScalpVertexColors.asset** is a real UMA MeshModifier. Its color adjustments
were applied through UMA's MeshModifier API to the original body's vertex array
to create **ShadedSourcePreview.asset**. There is one body surface and no scalp cap.

The reference body is unrigged. **PointyReviewBody** is a review-only vertex-range
binding, not a claim that the Blender vertex order matches any production UMA slot.
Do not attach this modifier to an arbitrary character recipe. For production,
create/open the groom on the built UMA character and use **Scalp Vertex Shading >
Create / Update & Apply Scalp Modifier** to capture verified slot ranges.
The skin shader must multiply by vertex RGB. Alpha is preserved by default.
Recipe/slot/overlay output is disabled for this raw DCC example until properly bound.

The saved scene's GeneratedCards mesh is a presentation snapshot. Rebuilding the
groom updates the Hair Card Stage; it does not silently overwrite that scene snapshot.

See [the full hairstyle guide](../../../../UMA/HairCards/SweptClumpsGuide.md)
for the native Unity workflow, including drawing Spline Flow paths instead of importing guides.
